commits.summary: Symbolic references in the own checker: paths that differ only in a reference merge, the reference a guarded choice of objects (H1, verification pending)
Array parameters that may be null or one array in property checks, decided by the own checker with witnesses that keep identity (H2, first step; verification pending)
Heap stream Progress: name the check errors that belong to other sessions' traces
Objects made by their constructor as regression inputs, compared on their fields as both versions leave them (H2, second step)
Results of classes made by their constructor compared by their fields, and identity relations within each version compared as holds-before-iff-holds-now (H3, first step)
A correspondence's input equations relate objects of different shapes in a regression check, and spec::heap::check runs the joint example's kernel claims (H5, narrow case)
Regression witnesses over objects run on a real JVM with their identities, the application's classes opened for the harness (H4, first step)
Propose a false public-ip finding for the allow list: a JVMS section number in a doc comment

Examples 150-152: a retry throttle as a mutable object input, a correct rewrite proved, the alias-to-copy defect refuted, a bug outside the constructor-made domain verified only within it (verification pending)
